assumption_profile.source_note: No measured KHU pressure traces or device dynamics available; illustrative assumptions only, NOT laboratory setpoints.

limitations: Uncalibrated screening model: no real-world backflow probability or safety certification.
Isothermal ideal gas; one upstream liquid branch and one gas branch at one junction.
Downstream lumped gas/liquid storage with homogeneous outlet; no slug, dissolution, reaction, capillary or gas-front model.
Negative liquid-branch flow means predicted liquid displacement, not proof that oxygen reaches Reactor 1.
Liquid compliance, pump response, MFC response, gas conductance and multiphase resistance require measurements.
Ideal algebraic BPR opening law; BPR hysteresis, valve closing dynamics and pressure-wave propagation are not resolved.
All alternative equipment and controls remain unapproved; no inventory or final design is changed by this tool.

proposed_alternatives: Unapproved mitigation proposal (requires chemistry, inventory, and O2-service review before adoption): Install a forward-oriented non-return valve (e.g., CV-3301, service-verified) on the liquid branch between Stage 1 outlet and the Stage 2 gas-introduction junction, protecting Stage 1 from reverse gas intrusion. This valve's cracking pressure concerns the pressure difference across it, not BPR minus cracking pressure. Its maximum pressure rating, O2 compatibility, and low-flow behaviour must be confirmed before use.

Unapproved mitigation proposal: A pressure-decoupled arrangement (e.g., intermediate collection and re-pressurisation) could isolate Stage 1 from Stage 2 gas pressure; this is not a designed or approved element and requires full engineering review.
Reducing gas flow alone does not resolve the unprotected reverse path on the liquid branch, as confirmed by the measured backflow event in the prior experiment and the topology finding.
limitations: Tool results are conditional on unmeasured parameters: illustrative viscosity (1.0 mPa·s), gas plenum (0.2 mL), MFC required ΔP (1.0 bar), pump response (1.0 s), liquid compliance (0.01 mL/bar), and multiphase resistance multiplier (3.0). These are not laboratory setpoints.
No reversal predicted in the finite simulation windows does not establish safe operation or exclude backflow under real startup, transient, or off-normal conditions.
Reported metric is predicted liquid displacement from the liquid branch at the junction, not oxygen reaching Stage 1 Reactor.

Candidates 3, 6, and 11 startup simulations did not reach BPR opening pressure; steady-state behaviour was only assessed with the hypothetical liquid check valve configuration, which is unassigned and service-unverified.
The CV-3301 check valve cracking pressure (1.0 bar) concerns the pressure difference across that valve; its maximum pressure rating is unconfirmed.
Isothermal ideal gas model; slug flow, gas dissolution, capillary effects, reaction, and gas-front dynamics are not modelled.
All alternative equipment and controls remain unapproved; no inventory or design is changed by the tool.
The prior experimental gas reverse flow observation (KHU, 15 Sep 2026) used unverified reference conditions and remains unresolved by these simulations.
BPR hysteresis, valve closing dynamics, and pressure-wave propagation are not resolved.
Pure O2 use is a gas-source change from the protocol (air); it is unapproved and requires laboratory review before use.

proposed_alternatives: A dedicated check valve (CV-3301 or equivalent) on the liquid branch between Stage 1 reactor outlet and the Stage 2 gas-introduction junction is an unapproved proposal: requires engineering review, inventory confirmation, service verification, and oxygen-compatibility assessment before use.
A pressure-decoupled interstage arrangement (e.g., gravity or pressure-controlled transfer) is an unapproved hypothesis requiring separate engineering and chemistry review.

Pure O2 gas supply in place of the batch air atmosphere is an unapproved gas-source change: requires chemist confirmation, oxygen-service review, and materials compatibility assessment before laboratory use.

CV-3301 cracking pressure (1.0 bar) concerns the differential pressure across that valve only; the valve on the MFC branch does not protect the liquid branch. Branch-specific protection on the liquid line is a separate unapproved item.
limitations: Tool uses illustrative, unmeasured parameters (viscosity, compliance, gas plenum, conductance, pump and MFC response times); results are conditional model outputs, not measured evidence or safety certification.

No liquid displacement predicted in entered-profile scenarios does not establish that backflow cannot occur; the unprotected liquid-branch reverse path (st2_mixer → st1_reactor) is an unresolved credible risk confirmed by the KHU qualitative observation.

Candidates 3, 6, and 11 (as-designed, gas-first startup): BPR opening pressure was not reached within the simulated window; steady-state behaviour during full pressurisation is unconfirmed for those as-designed cases.
Predicted quantities are liquid displacement at the junction, not confirmation that oxygen reaches Stage 1 Reactor; actual gas transport through the liquid column is not modelled.
Gas check-valve cracking pressure (1.0 bar) governs pressure difference across that valve; it does not set a minimum system pressure margin above which backflow is precluded.
Isothermal ideal-gas model; no slug, dissolution, capillary, multiphase front, or reaction model included.
Finite scenario window; no lifetime, frequency, or reliability assessment is provided.
Hypothetical liquid-branch check valve is not assigned, not service-verified, and not in the approved inventory; zero leakage assumed is an idealisation.
CV-3301 maximum pressure rating not supplied; suitability at 7 bar or 8 bar system pressures requires laboratory verification before use.
All candidates share the same unresolved reverse-path finding (BF-REVERSE-PATH:st2_mixer:s3:st1_reactor); reducing gas flow does not close this path.
Acrylonitrile is listed as excluded from RED pump tubing; all candidates correctly assign liquid feed to BLUE pump, but solvent-wetted component compatibility beyond pump tubing should be confirmed.

DrChemistry.justification: Baseline: Stage 1 tau=100 min (0.42× batch) in 2 mL PFA/UV-150 450 nm; Stage 2 tau_inlet=181.8 min (0.51× batch) in 20 mL FEP/Manual2, BPR 7 bar. Balanced stage ratios. Interpretable anchor for comparison. Backflow unresolved (shared); all other checks pass.
uncertainties: Stage 1 at 100 min (0.42× batch) may be inadequate for Giese reaction; uncharacterized.
Stage 2 apparent tau is inlet/STP index only; liquid exposure much longer but unverified.
Backflow: unprotected reverse path to Stage 1 unresolved.
CV-3301 pressure rating unconfirmed.
O2 service and gas-source change unapproved.

DrChemistry.justification: Stage 1 identical to C1 (100 min, 0.42×). Stage 2 same reactor (20 mL FEP) and inlet tau (181.8 min) but BPR 2.5 bar; in-channel gas volume larger (0.028 mL/min vs 0.012 mL/min), potentially different gas-liquid contact. Useful BPR comparison to C1. Backflow unresolved (shared).
uncertainties: Lower BPR may increase gas void fraction; gas-liquid mass transfer and slug stability uncharacterized.
Stage 1 adequacy at 100 min uncharacterized.
Backflow: unprotected reverse path unresolved.
CV-3301 rating unconfirmed; O2 service unapproved.

DrChemistry.justification: Stage 1 tau=250 min (1.04× batch) in 5 mL ETFE/UV-150; provides near-batch Stage 1 exposure. Stage 2 tau_inlet=181.8 min (0.51×) in 20 mL FEP, BPR 7 bar. Large-bore ETFE in Stage 1 (2.4 mm ID, Re≈0.18) is laminar; photon penetration depth at 2.4 mm bore unverified. Backflow unresolved.
uncertainties: ETFE 2.4 mm bore: photon penetration and mixing at Re≈0.18 uncharacterized in UV-150.
Stage 2 apparent tau 0.51× batch; adequacy uncharacterized.
Backflow unresolved; CV-3301 unconfirmed; O2 service unapproved.

DrChemistry.justification: Stage 1 tau=100 min (0.42×) in 2 mL PFA; Stage 2 tau_inlet=181.8 min in 20 mL FEP, BPR 1.5 bar. Lowest BPR of the 20 mL FEP group; highest in-channel gas volume fraction (0.040 mL/min). Useful low-BPR comparison point. Stage 1 adequacy and backflow unresolved.
uncertainties: BPR 1.5 bar: largest gas void fraction among FEP 20 mL candidates; slug flow stability uncharacterized.
Stage 1 at 100 min (0.42×) may be insufficient.
Backflow unresolved; CV-3301 unconfirmed; O2 service unapproved.

DrChemistry.justification: Stage 1 tau=100 min (0.42×) in 2 mL PFA; Stage 2 tau_inlet=90.9 min (0.25×) in 10 mL ETFE 2.4 mm, BPR 7 bar. Shortest apparent Stage 2 index in the set. Stage 2 exposure substantially below batch anchor; adequacy is an open question. ETFE large bore in Stage 2 may affect gas distribution.
uncertainties: Stage 2 at 0.25× batch may be insufficient for sulfide oxidation; uncharacterized.
ETFE 2.4 mm bore Stage 2: gas-liquid distribution uncharacterized.
Stage 1 at 0.42× may be insufficient.
Backflow unresolved; CV-3301 unconfirmed; O2 service unapproved.

DrChemistry.justification: Stage 1 tau=250 min (1.04×) in 5 mL PFA 1 mm/UV-150; near-batch Stage 1 in a narrow-bore coil with better photon penetration than ETFE 2.4 mm. Stage 2 tau_inlet=181.8 min (0.51×) in 20 mL FEP, BPR 7 bar. Preferred Stage 1 geometry among near-batch Stage 1 candidates. Backflow unresolved.
uncertainties: Stage 2 at 0.51× batch; oxidation adequacy uncharacterized.
Backflow unresolved; CV-3301 unconfirmed; O2 service unapproved.
5 mL PFA quantity: 2 available; one consumed here, leaving one for other use.

DrChemistry.justification: Stage 1 tau=100 min (0.42×) in 2 mL PFA; Stage 2 tau_inlet=90.9 min (0.25×) in 10 mL PFA 1 mm, BPR 7 bar. Short Stage 2 in narrow-bore PFA; no large-bore concern. Both stages substantially below batch. Provides short-time comparison point against C1 and C6. Backflow unresolved.
uncertainties: Both stages significantly below batch anchors; adequacy uncharacterized.
Backflow unresolved; CV-3301 unconfirmed; O2 service unapproved.

DrChemistry.justification: Stage 1 tau=100 min (0.42×) in 2 mL PFA; Stage 2 tau_inlet=90.9 min (0.25×) in 10 mL FEP 1 mm (max 50 °C), BPR 7 bar. FEP temperature ceiling 50 °C is not limiting at 25 °C screen. Functionally identical to C7 in times; differs only in Stage 2 material (FEP vs PFA). Redundant with C7 unless material comparison is intended.
uncertainties: FEP coil max 50 °C limits future temperature exploration in Stage 2.
Both stages below batch; adequacy uncharacterized.
Backflow unresolved; CV-3301 unconfirmed; O2 service unapproved.

DrChemistry.justification: Stage 1 tau=250 min (1.04×) in 5 mL ETFE 2.4 mm; Stage 2 tau_inlet=90.9 min (0.25×) in 10 mL ETFE 2.4 mm, BPR 7 bar. Near-batch Stage 1 but large-bore throughout; photon penetration concern in both stages. Short Stage 2. Backflow unresolved. All-ETFE design limits photon penetration assessment.
uncertainties: Large bore (2.4 mm) in both stages: photon penetration and gas-liquid distribution uncharacterized.
Stage 2 at 0.25× batch may be insufficient.
Backflow unresolved; CV-3301 unconfirmed; O2 service unapproved.

DrChemistry.justification: Stage 1 tau=100 min (0.42×) in 2 mL PFA; Stage 2 tau_inlet=90.9 min (0.25×) in 10 mL ETFE 2.4 mm, BPR 2.5 bar. Lower BPR increases in-channel gas volume vs C5; may affect slug stability. ETFE large bore Stage 2 concern retained. Provides BPR vs C5 comparison for large-bore Stage 2.
uncertainties: ETFE 2.4 mm Stage 2 with BPR 2.5 bar: larger gas void fraction; slug stability uncharacterized.
Stage 1 and Stage 2 both below batch.
Backflow unresolved; CV-3301 unconfirmed; O2 service unapproved.

DrChemistry.justification: Stage 1 tau=250 min (1.04×) in 5 mL ETFE 2.4 mm; Stage 2 tau_inlet=90.9 min (0.25×) in 10 mL PFA 1 mm, BPR 7 bar. Near-batch Stage 1 (large bore, photon concern) with short narrow-bore Stage 2. Mixes bore geometries across stages; provides near-batch Stage 1 with short Stage 2 in PFA. Backflow unresolved.
uncertainties: ETFE 2.4 mm Stage 1: photon penetration at Re≈0.18 uncharacterized.
Stage 2 at 0.25× batch; oxidation adequacy uncharacterized.
Backflow unresolved; CV-3301 unconfirmed; O2 service unapproved.

DrChemistry.justification: Stage 1 tau=100 min (0.42×) in 2 mL PFA; Stage 2 tau_inlet=90.9 min (0.25×) in 10 mL PFA 1 mm, BPR 2.5 bar. Narrow bore both stages; lower BPR than C7. Useful BPR comparison to C7. Both stages well below batch. Functionally overlaps C7 and C10 in screen space.
uncertainties: Both stages below batch; adequacy for both reactions uncharacterized.
Lower BPR increases gas void fraction vs C7.
Backflow unresolved; CV-3301 unconfirmed; O2 service unapproved.

DrKinetics.justification: S1: 2 mL PFA, τ_liq=100 min (0.42× batch). S2: 20 mL FEP, τ_inlet=181.8 min (0.50× batch), BPR 7 bar, O2 0.09 sccm, 2.01 equiv. Provides a mid-range S1/S2 combination as a baseline. Backflow and O2-service issues unresolved but not a hard violation absent confirmed occurrence.
uncertainties: S1 liquid τ 0.42× batch; adequacy for Giese completion unproven.
S2 inlet/STP index 0.50× batch; liquid exposure ~1000 min (unconstrained by gas index).
Unprotected liquid reverse path to S1 unresolved across all candidates.
CV-3301 pressure rating unconfirmed; O2-service compatibility unreviewed.
Stage 2 temperature not batch-resolved.

DrKinetics.justification: Identical reactor geometry to C1 but BPR 2.5 bar; lower system pressure increases gas volumetric fraction in S2 (0.028 mL/min vs 0.012 mL/min in-channel), potentially aiding gas-liquid contact. Same S1 τ limitation. BPR difference is a useful screen variable alongside C1.
uncertainties: Lower BPR reduces O2 solubility in S2; net effect on oxidation unproven.
Same unprotected liquid reverse path as all candidates.
S1 τ 0.42× batch; Giese completion unproven.
CV-3301 and O2-service unreviewed.

DrKinetics.justification: S1: 5 mL ETFE (ID 2.4 mm), τ_liq=250 min (1.04× batch), BPR 7 bar. S2: 20 mL FEP, τ_inlet=181.8 min. Exceeds batch S1 time; provides near-batch S1 anchor. ETFE large bore reduces surface/volume for photon delivery vs protocol geometry; uncharacterized impact.
uncertainties: ETFE 2.4 mm bore: photon penetration depth uncharacterized vs batch.
S2 inlet/STP index 0.50× batch; same as C1.
Unprotected liquid reverse path unresolved.
O2-service and CV-3301 unreviewed.

DrKinetics.justification: S1: 2 mL PFA, τ_liq=100 min (0.42× batch), BPR 1.5 bar. S2: 20 mL FEP, τ_inlet=181.8 min. Lowest BPR in 20 mL FEP group; highest in-channel gas volumetric fraction (0.040 mL/min). Useful low-pressure screen point. Stage 1 τ limitation same as C1.
uncertainties: BPR 1.5 bar: lowest system pressure; O2 solubility in S2 lowest of this group.
S1 τ 0.42× batch; Giese completion unproven.
Unprotected liquid reverse path unresolved.
CV-3301 and O2-service unreviewed.

DrKinetics.justification: S1: 2 mL PFA, τ_liq=100 min (0.42× batch). S2: 10 mL ETFE (ID 2.4 mm), τ_inlet=90.9 min (0.25× batch), BPR 7 bar. Shortest S2 inlet-index; large bore may improve gas dispersion but reduces liquid τ index further. Useful short-S2 reference with ETFE geometry.
uncertainties: S2 τ_inlet 0.25× batch; oxidation completeness most uncertain in this set.

DrKinetics.justification: S1: 5 mL PFA (ID 1 mm), τ_liq=250 min (1.04× batch), BPR 7 bar. S2: 20 mL FEP, τ_inlet=181.8 min. Near-batch S1 with narrower bore than C3; better photon geometry for S1. Paired with C3 allows bore effect assessment in S1.
uncertainties: S2 inlet/STP index 0.50× batch same as C1/C3.
S1 near-batch τ does not guarantee equivalent conversion; no kinetics.

shared_assessment.gas_source_change: Pure O2 replacing batch air is a gas-source change. source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is not explicitly set to true in the schema field, but the intake record (Q-GAS-001) records this as a user-confirmed requirement and the measured-evidence context notes the prior experiment used O2 without design approval, resulting in observed reverse flow. Pure O2 use remains unapproved for oxygen-service purposes across all candidates and must undergo chemist, inventory, and oxygen-service review before laboratory execution.
shared_assessment.reverse_path_finding: All twelve candidates share an unresolved credible risk: BF-REVERSE-PATH:st2_mixer:s3:st1_reactor. The liquid branch between Stage 1 outlet and the Stage 2 gas-introduction junction carries no forward-oriented non-return protection. The CV-3301 check valve is declared only on the MFC (gas) branch; it does not protect the liquid branch. A valve on one branch does not protect a different branch. The KHU qualitative observation (15 Sep 2026) of gas reverse flow is unresolved measured evidence. Reducing gas flow does not close this unprotected reverse path. No simulation result — including the tool's prediction of zero liquid displacement — establishes that backflow cannot occur: the tool uses illustrative unmeasured parameters and a finite scenario window, and its output is predicted liquid displacement at the junction, not confirmation that oxygen reaches or does not reach Stage 1. This finding requires branch-specific engineering review before any candidate is executed.
shared_assessment.physics_tool_status: DrFluidics and DrSafety results are conditional on unmeasured illustrative parameters (viscosity 1.0 mPa·s, gas plenum 0.2 mL, MFC ΔP 1.0 bar, liquid compliance 0.01 mL/bar, multiphase resistance multiplier 3.0). No reversal predicted in these finite scenario windows does not establish safety or exclude backflow under real startup, off-normal, or shutdown conditions. Candidates 3, 6, and 11 gas-first startup simulations did not reach BPR opening pressure within the simulated window; steady-state behaviour for those as-designed cases is unconfirmed.
shared_assessment.cv3301_pressure_rating: CV-3301 cracking pressure is 1.0 bar; this concerns the pressure difference across that valve. The maximum pressure rating of CV-3301 is not supplied and must be verified before use at 7 bar or 8 bar system pressures. Cracking pressure is not a pressure rating.
shared_assessment.stage2_temperature: Stage 2 batch temperature is not stage-resolved in the protocol. All candidates assign 25°C; this is unverified. No validated rate correction or yield consequence can be stated.
shared_assessment.stage2_gas_residence_time: Stage 2 Q_gas_sccm and Q_gas_STP values are gas volume at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). The apparent residence-time index V/(Q_liquid + Q_gas_STP) is not a measured liquid residence time or photon exposure index. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake.
shared_assessment.wavelength_note: Protocol specifies 452 nm. Assigned light sources are UV-150/450 nm (Stage 1) and Manual 2/448 nm (Stage 2). These are nearest available; adequacy for catalyst excitation is not established.
shared_assessment.acrylonitrile_pump: Acrylonitrile is excluded from RED pump tubing. All candidates assign liquid feed to BLUE pump; this is consistent with the exclusion constraint.
shared_assessment.no_kinetic_data: Kinetics are uncharacterized for both stages. Stage-hold ratios are exposure indices only. No yield, conversion, or rate superiority can be inferred from any ratio or residence-time comparison. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice; short times are not inherently failures.
shared_assessment.large_bore_ETFE_photon: Candidates using ETFE 5 mL or 10 mL coils (ID 2.4 mm) in Stage 1 or Stage 2 carry an uncharacterized photon penetration uncertainty. The batch protocol used a narrow-bore tube irradiated at close range; 2.4 mm ID reduces surface-to-volume ratio and increases path length. This is an unresolved experimental uncertainty, not a hard violation.
shared_assessment.FEP_temperature: FEP coils (coil_row6, coil_row7) have max temperature 50°C. At the 25°C screen temperature this is not a constraint, but it limits future elevated-temperature exploration at Stage 2 for candidates using those reactors.

required_measurements: Branch-specific non-return protection on the liquid line between Stage 1 outlet and the Stage 2 gas-introduction junction: verify device identity, service direction, cracking pressure differential, maximum pressure rating, O2 compatibility, and low-flow seating behaviour before execution of any candidate.
CV-3301 maximum pressure rating: must be confirmed independently from cracking pressure specification before use at system pressures up to 7–8 bar.

Chemist and oxygen-service review of pure O2 substitution for the batch air atmosphere: O2 concentration, materials compatibility, MFC service range, and laboratory safety approval required before any candidate is executed.

Gas supply pressure and MFC inlet differential pressure at operating conditions: required to validate model margin estimates; illustrative values (12 bar supply, 1.0 bar ΔP required) are not measured setpoints.
Stage 2 batch temperature: protocol does not resolve a temperature for Stage 2; confirm operating temperature before designing rate or yield expectations.
Startup sequence and pressure traces for Stage 1–Stage 2 connected operation: required to validate or falsify the unresolved backflow risk and simulation predictions.
Photon penetration depth for 2.4 mm ID ETFE coils (Stage 1 in C3, C6 startup comparison; C9, C11): verify irradiance at reaction locus relative to 452 nm protocol lamp at 3 cm distance.
Stage 1 Giese conversion as a function of flow residence time: minimum data point needed to select a Stage 1 reactor for yield-optimised operation.
Stage 2 oxidation completion as a function of flow residence time and O2 equivalent at 7 bar and 2.5 bar: required to distinguish among Stage 2 reactor and BPR options.

screening_policy: Fixed exploratory stage-time multipliers relative to explicit batch holds; these are not kinetic predictions.
objective: Develop a safe, reproducible, and inventory-compatible two-stage flow process that maximizes the final yield of sulfoxide 4a while avoiding unnecessarily long residence times. Design the two stages as one connected process, because Stage 1 determines the composition entering Stage 2.

objective_policy.objective: Develop a safe, reproducible, and inventory-compatible two-stage flow process that maximizes the final yield of sulfoxide 4a while avoiding unnecessarily long residence times. Design the two stages as one connected process, because Stage 1 determines the composition entering Stage 2.
objective_policy.selection_instruction: Establish an interpretable baseline and compare shorter and longer stage holds.
objective_policy.interpretation_note: Ambiguous or unrecognized wording uses a balanced screen; select a priority explicitly to override.

findings.consequence: Possible upstream gas intrusion and displacement; upstream chemistry and stage residence may be disrupted.
findings.required_action: Review branch-specific non-return protection and pressure control, or a pressure-decoupled arrangement. Confirm equipment and service suitability before use.

A valve on the MFC branch does not protect a different inlet branch.
Lower gas volume does not close an unprotected reverse path.

selection.objective_alignment: Balanced priority requires an interpretable starting point from which shorter and longer stage holds can be compared. C1 anchors the screen at 0.42× batch (S1) and 0.51× batch (S2), covering sub-batch exposure for both stages simultaneously. This is not the shortest or longest design; it is the mid-range combination that allows yield data from a single run to direct subsequent experiments toward longer S1 (C3, C6) or longer S2 (if both 0.42× and 0.51× prove insufficient), or shorter (C7, C12) if both are already excessive. BPR 7 bar provides the highest O2 pressure head among FEP-20 mL candidates, minimising one source of Stage 2 variability. No yield or conversion can be inferred; adequacy of either stage is uncharacterized.

alternatives.reason_not_selected: S1 at 250 min (1.04× batch) in 5 mL PFA 1 mm provides near-batch Stage 1 exposure and is the preferred near-batch S1 candidate (narrow bore, better photon geometry than ETFE 2.4 mm). However, gas-first as-designed startup simulation did not reach BPR opening pressure within the finite window, leaving full steady-state startup behaviour unconfirmed. Under balanced priority with no prior data, spending the first experiment on a near-batch S1 condition without confirming startup operability is less efficient than C1 as an anchor. If C1 data show Stage 1 conversion is limiting, C6 becomes the priority follow-up.

S1: 100 min (0.42× batch, same as C1); S2: 10 mL PFA 1 mm, τ_inlet=90.9 min (0.25× batch), BPR 7 bar. Provides the short-S2, short-S1 bracketing point. S2 apparent index is the lowest among narrow-bore 7-bar candidates; if oxidation requires closer to batch time, this condition risks insufficient Stage 2 exposure without yielding diagnostic information. C1's longer S2 (181.8 min, 0.51× batch) is more likely to produce detectable product, making C1 more informative as the first experiment. C7 is the recommended short-S2 follow-up after C1.

S1: 5 mL ETFE 2.4 mm, τ_liq=250 min (1.04× batch); S2: 20 mL FEP, τ_inlet=181.8 min, BPR 7 bar. Near-batch S1 in large-bore ETFE; photon penetration at 2.4 mm ID is uncharacterized relative to the batch narrow-tube geometry. Additionally, gas-first as-designed startup simulation did not reach BPR opening pressure (finite window). The combination of uncharacterized photon delivery and unconfirmed startup makes C3 less interpretable as a first experiment than C1 (PFA 1 mm, simpler startup profile). If S1 is rate-limiting, C6 (same τ, narrow bore, confirmed photon geometry) is preferred over C3.

council_answer_assessments.effect: Pure O2 confirmed by chemist (Q-GAS-001); however, this is an unapproved gas-source change relative to the batch air atmosphere and requires oxygen-service review and laboratory safety confirmation before use. The answer sets the gas identity but does not establish approval for oxygen service.

Oxygen introduction at Stage 2 inlet only is implemented in C1 (and all candidates). The unprotected liquid-branch reverse path means this constraint cannot be guaranteed without branch-specific non-return protection; this remains unresolved.

The KHU qualitative backflow observation (15 Sep 2026) is the only measured operability evidence. It directly motivates the unresolved reverse-path finding and confirms that reducing gas flow alone does not resolve the topology risk. It does not quantify backflow rate or conditions.

Stage 1 oxygen exclusion depends on resolving the liquid-branch reverse path before execution. Stage 2 oxygen availability is determined by BPR (7 bar in C1 maximises O2 partial pressure) and inlet equivalents (2.01 equiv); gas-liquid mass transfer is uncharacterized. The hypothesis that Stage 1 sulfide formation limits Stage 2 oxidation cannot be tested until Stage 1 conversion data are available.

applies_to_all_candidates: Unprotected liquid-branch reverse path: gas introduction junction (Stage 2) connects directly to Stage 1 reactor via the liquid branch with no forward-oriented non-return valve on that branch. The CV-3301 check valve is declared only on the MFC (gas) branch and does not protect the liquid branch. This is an unresolved credible risk (BF-REVERSE-PATH:st2_mixer:s3:st1_reactor) across all twelve candidates. Reducing gas flow does not close this path. Branch-specific non-return protection on the liquid line must be reviewed before any candidate is executed.

Pure O2 substitution: The protocol specifies air (ambient atmosphere). Use of pure O2 was not approved in the original design; the prior experiment used O2 without design approval and observed reverse flow. Pure O2 use constitutes an unapproved gas-source change requiring chemist confirmation, oxygen-service review, and materials compatibility assessment before laboratory execution.

CV-3301 pressure rating: Cracking pressure (1.0 bar) is not a pressure rating. Maximum pressure rating of CV-3301 is unconfirmed and must be verified before use at 7–8 bar system pressures. The cracking pressure concerns the differential pressure across that valve, not BPR minus cracking pressure.

Physics tool results: DrFluidics and DrSafety outputs are conditional on illustrative unmeasured parameters (viscosity 1.0 mPa·s, gas plenum 0.2 mL, MFC ΔP 1.0 bar, liquid compliance 0.01 mL/bar, multiphase resistance multiplier 3.0). No liquid displacement predicted does not establish safe operation or exclude backflow under real startup, transient, or shutdown conditions. Tool output is predicted liquid displacement at the junction, not confirmation that oxygen reaches or does not reach Stage 1.

Gas residence-time index: Q_gas_sccm and Q_gas_STP values are gas volume at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). The apparent Stage 2 index V/(Q_liquid + Q_gas_STP) is not a measured liquid residence time or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed inlet molar ratios, not measured stoichiometric uptake.
Wavelength: Protocol specifies 452 nm. UV-150/450 nm (Stage 1) and Manual 2/448 nm (Stage 2) are nearest available; photon adequacy for catalyst excitation is not established.
Stage 2 temperature: Not batch-resolved. All candidates assign 25°C; no validated rate correction is available.
Kinetics: Uncharacterized for both stages. No yield, conversion, or rate superiority can be inferred from any hold ratio.
Acrylonitrile: Excluded from RED pump tubing. All candidates assign liquid feed to BLUE pump; consistent with exclusion constraint.

shared_assessment.gas_source_change: Pure O2 replacing batch air is a gas-source change. source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is not explicitly set to true in the schema field, but the intake record (Q-GAS-001) records this as a user-confirmed requirement and the measured-evidence context notes the prior experiment used O2 without design approval, resulting in observed reverse flow. Pure O2 use remains unapproved for oxygen-service purposes across all candidates and must undergo chemist, inventory, and oxygen-service review before laboratory execution.
shared_assessment.reverse_path_finding: All twelve candidates share an unresolved credible risk: BF-REVERSE-PATH:st2_mixer:s3:st1_reactor. The liquid branch between Stage 1 outlet and the Stage 2 gas-introduction junction carries no forward-oriented non-return protection. The CV-3301 check valve is declared only on the MFC (gas) branch; it does not protect the liquid branch. A valve on one branch does not protect a different branch. The KHU qualitative observation (15 Sep 2026) of gas reverse flow is unresolved measured evidence. Reducing gas flow does not close this unprotected reverse path. No simulation result — including the tool's prediction of zero liquid displacement — establishes that backflow cannot occur: the tool uses illustrative unmeasured parameters and a finite scenario window, and its output is predicted liquid displacement at the junction, not confirmation that oxygen reaches or does not reach Stage 1. This finding requires branch-specific engineering review before any candidate is executed.
shared_assessment.physics_tool_status: DrFluidics and DrSafety results are conditional on unmeasured illustrative parameters (viscosity 1.0 mPa·s, gas plenum 0.2 mL, MFC ΔP 1.0 bar, liquid compliance 0.01 mL/bar, multiphase resistance multiplier 3.0). No reversal predicted in these finite scenario windows does not establish safety or exclude backflow under real startup, off-normal, or shutdown conditions. Candidates 3, 6, and 11 gas-first startup simulations did not reach BPR opening pressure within the simulated window; steady-state behaviour for those as-designed cases is unconfirmed.

The maximum pressure rating of CV-3301 is not supplied and must be verified before use at 7 bar or 8 bar system pressures. Cracking pressure is not a pressure rating.
shared_assessment.stage2_temperature: Stage 2 batch temperature is not stage-resolved in the protocol. All candidates assign 25°C; this is unverified. No validated rate correction or yield consequence can be stated.
shared_assessment.stage2_gas_residence_time: Stage 2 Q_gas_sccm and Q_gas_STP values are gas volume at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). The apparent residence-time index V/(Q_liquid + Q_gas_STP) is not a measured liquid residence time or photon exposure index. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake.
shared_assessment.wavelength_note: Protocol specifies 452 nm. Assigned light sources are UV-150/450 nm (Stage 1) and Manual 2/448 nm (Stage 2). These are nearest available; adequacy for catalyst excitation is not established.
shared_assessment.acrylonitrile_pump: Acrylonitrile is excluded from RED pump tubing. All candidates assign liquid feed to BLUE pump; this is consistent with the exclusion constraint.
shared_assessment.no_kinetic_data: Kinetics are uncharacterized for both stages. Stage-hold ratios are exposure indices only. No yield, conversion, or rate superiority can be inferred from any ratio or residence-time comparison. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice; short times are not inherently failures.
shared_assessment.large_bore_ETFE_photon: Candidates using ETFE 5 mL or 10 mL coils (ID 2.4 mm) in Stage 1 or Stage 2 carry an uncharacterized photon penetration uncertainty. The batch protocol used a narrow-bore tube irradiated at close range; 2.4 mm ID reduces surface-to-volume ratio and increases path length. This is an unresolved experimental uncertainty, not a hard violation.
shared_assessment.FEP_temperature: FEP coils (coil_row6, coil_row7) have max temperature 50°C. At the 25°C screen temperature this is not a constraint, but it limits future elevated-temperature exploration at Stage 2 for candidates using those reactors.

required_measurements: Branch-specific non-return protection on the liquid line between Stage 1 outlet and the Stage 2 gas-introduction junction: verify device identity, service direction, cracking pressure differential, maximum pressure rating, O2 compatibility, and low-flow seating behaviour before execution of any candidate.
CV-3301 maximum pressure rating: must be confirmed independently from cracking pressure specification before use at system pressures up to 7–8 bar.

Chemist and oxygen-service review of pure O2 substitution for the batch air atmosphere: O2 concentration, materials compatibility, MFC service range, and laboratory safety approval required before any candidate is executed.

Gas supply pressure and MFC inlet differential pressure at operating conditions: required to validate model margin estimates; illustrative values (12 bar supply, 1.0 bar ΔP required) are not measured setpoints.
Stage 2 batch temperature: protocol does not resolve a temperature for Stage 2; confirm operating temperature before designing rate or yield expectations.
Startup sequence and pressure traces for Stage 1–Stage 2 connected operation: required to validate or falsify the unresolved backflow risk and simulation predictions.
Photon penetration depth for 2.4 mm ID ETFE coils (Stage 1 in C3, C6 startup comparison; C9, C11): verify irradiance at reaction locus relative to 452 nm protocol lamp at 3 cm distance.
Stage 1 Giese conversion as a function of flow residence time: minimum data point needed to select a Stage 1 reactor for yield-optimised operation.
Stage 2 oxidation completion as a function of flow residence time and O2 equivalent at 7 bar and 2.5 bar: required to distinguish among Stage 2 reactor and BPR options.
Acrylonitrile compatibility and solubility in EtOH:pH 9 buffer at 0.2 M stock concentration: confirm no precipitation or phase separation in the pump and inlet tubing at 0.02 mL/min.
